title: Answer: takes no position on measurement in physics, uses complexity measures as proxies

statements.text: IWMT takes no position on measurement in quantum physics. Its quantum analogies for ignition and the Bayesian blur are offered as highly speculative metaphors for information dynamics. It observes consciousness through report and through measures such as the perturbational complexity index used as proxies for integrated information.

sources.quote: these are all (very) highly speculative analogies for information dynamics
While PCI measures can potentially be explained without appealing to IIT, they can nonetheless be used as proxies for integrated information.
